phases.name: migrate
phases.contract: Unchanged production run_migrations identity applies additive 0226 and Apalis. 0226 creates six empty relations and clears inherited PUBLIC/table/column ACL exposure transactionally, owned by console_app pending finalization. It may not claim final custody. No owner transfer attempted by console_app.

phases.name: finalize
phases.contract: Existing separately authenticated administrator executes fixed, release-bound SQL on the intended DB. No arbitrary SQL/object/owner input. Use one transaction, fixed ordered relation locks, local lock_timeout 5s and statement_timeout 60s. Validate exact relation kinds, columns, constraints and validated composite FKs, source ownership, zero membership reachability, expected ACLs, no partition/inheritance or shadow relations, and emptiness before any ownership change. Transfer exact six relations to fixed owners, remove only expected staging ACLs, recheck final catalog and all effective table/column/SET access before commit. Unknown owner, mixed ownership, nonempty staging, unexpected grants, shape or trigger/rule drift fails with no repair. Finalized exact state is read-only idempotent success; never transfer back to console_app.

phases.name: admit
phases.contract: For DB-backed api and worker, AppState::from_config performs the shared catalog custody verifier before returning a usable state or starting consumers; readyz rechecks actual metadata and returns unavailable on missing, partial, pending or drifted custody. Direct binary launch cannot bypass this gate. Migrate is exempt from serving custody admission so it can create staging. The existing genuine no-database test configuration follows its existing behavior and cannot be enabled to bypass a configured DB failure. Deployment finalization success is required in addition to, not instead of, live catalog readback. The verifier requires no private-row reads, administrator secret or new access grants. Account enrollment remains disabled until its independent global fence and owner contracts pass. Place startup check before from_config starts realtime/mail consumers. readyz degradation is detection and routing signal; it does not stop an already running worker. Owner-command revalidation and safe worker stop/drain for activated Account operations remain their later acceptance boundary.

provenance: Production operator wrapper validates target DB and successful release-bound SQLx migration ledger/checksums plus actual migration-job success, then invokes shared structural SQL. Missing ledger or checksum mismatch is a production failure; no bypass flag. The shared SQL independently checks exact physical prerequisites and is the same statement boundary used by marked SQLx fixtures and raw migration experiments. Raw probes lack SQLx ledger legitimately, invoke shared SQL directly through their administrator, retain source/order execution manifest, and cannot be claimed as production-wrapper or app startup proof.

future_ddl: This v1 finalizer is a single immutable six-table custody transition, not a generic privileged migration engine. Once transferred, console_app cannot ALTER these tables or add referencing FKs without separate authority. Subsequent Account/credential/actor DDL must use versioned operator-owned transitions through the same isolated operator lifecycle, with exact migration order/checksum, populated-data compatibility and tests approved before that lane. Never reclaim ownership, add REFERENCES/SET grants, or widen v1 silently. This is a dependency of the next Account lane and remains HOLD, not an omitted production guarantee. Before the next dependent Account lane, establish versioned operator/application migration ordering and replace the frozen v1 verifier under its own reviewed revision. No dependent ALTER/FK may be appended to the ordinary all-at-once MIGRATOR and then expect a later finalizer to repair its earlier permission failure.
rollback: Before enrollment, a failed finalizer transaction rolls back all changes and leaves empty staging inaccessible. On uncertain commit, inspect exact whole post-state; completed state succeeds read-only, pending state retries the same bounded transaction, mixed/drifted state stops. Do not drop tables, erase history, restore legacy credentials or revoke Account fences. Software rollback differs from data rollback; no down migration or automatic custody reversal.

privileged_transport.identity: The selected zero-membership mechanism requires a directly authenticated PostgreSQL SUPERUSER. Assert session_user = current_user = independently configured expected operator role, rolsuper=true, operator distinct from every application/auth/owner role. This exception is confined to the trusted one-shot operator process; run_migrations and all serving identity checks remain unchanged. No grant or SET ROLE enables the operator.
privileged_transport.blast_radius: The intended transaction changes only six named relations; a compromised administrator credential has cluster-wide authority. Per-DB SQL checks do not reduce the credential capability. Short-lived operator secret custody, process/image provenance and isolated network access are necessary operational controls, not a mathematical containment claim.
privileged_transport.target_binding: Require an independently supplied deployment target descriptor from protected operator inventory: expected PostgreSQL system_identifier, database name and database OID, plus production TLS endpoint/peer identity. Compare pg_control_system(), current_database() and pg_database OID readback against the descriptor; do not derive expected values from the connection DSN or target readback inside finalizer. Wrong-target tests use two structurally identical migrated databases and distinct cluster descriptors. Restore/clone changes require a reviewed inventory rebind; a database name alone is insufficient. Production connections use verified TLS peer identity; sandbox experiments identify the exclusive container and cannot certify remote identity.
privileged_transport.packaging: Dedicated operator image derived from postgres:18.6@sha256:4ef4dbc939d61acea57712655ddb4b4ab27419c913f94cca0cd57cb3ea3c2280; fixed COPY of finalizer shell/SQL and generated numbered-migration checksum manifest from the exact candidate. Pin resulting image digest in deployment and verify its release signature/provenance. No downloaded script, mutable command or caller SQL. Application image remains free of psql/admin credentials.
privileged_transport.kubernetes_order: Prerequisite operator-infrastructure rollout must install target descriptor, distinct operator Secret binding, admission/image trust and the narrow NetworkPolicy allowances before application PreSync is invoked. Then explicit migrate PreSync wave -20, finalizer PreSync wave -10, normal application sync. A missing prerequisite blocks release; a NetworkPolicy introduced only during later normal Sync cannot satisfy the first PreSync. No real Secret, policy rollout, image publication or cluster mutation is authorized by this local amendment.
privileged_transport.network: Under enforcing CNI, extend PostgreSQL ingress to exact console-migrate and console-account-finalizer labels. Apply default-deny egress to both job labels and allow only approved DNS and selected PostgreSQL endpoint/port; no HTTP/HTTPS general egress and no Kubernetes API access. Disable service-account token mount; nonroot/read-only filesystem/capability drop and bounded retry/deadline. This includes correcting the existing migration-label ingress omission before exposure.
privileged_transport.exposure_gate: Operator image production signing, independent target inventory and privilege binding, prerequisites rollout, enforcing-CNI positive/negative network tests and recovery drill are required before production exposure. They are not represented as existing infrastructure or as already certified by local SQL tests.
